reference_strokes.excluded_from_improvement_estimates: First EthLib prototype capture had a 53 ms report-unit check while its driver was active. All four Riemann captures have no concurrent builds/tests/other samplers. No speedup is inferred from fewer attributes.
reference_strokes.candidate_regressions: Draft geometry/retained-reference-width test changes were never run and restored; their private patch is not validation.

background_grouping.method: Actual ordered 12511-area frame replay, current font, fresh surfaces, separate draw/forced-readback times; not native interaction or physical presentation.

limits: Counts are observed instant reasons, not milliseconds or disjoint CPU work; style and layout notifications may refer to the same update.
Extra invalidation tracing uses a bounded 512 MiB buffer and changes timing; final diagnostic timing is not used as a latency comparison.
Missing/ambiguous document marks, lossy/unknown completion and invalid/missing dispatch attribution are refusal, never zero work.
Synchronous dispatch excludes later asynchronous work; two-rAF and sampled frame intervals are not physical presentation or field INP.
Existing caches and ordinary desktop activity are uncontrolled; no universal speedup claim.
New-file full-input validation and the first-detail stall remain separate migration work.
